# Folahan Williams

> Folahan Williams is a 16-year-old founder and the creator of Decision Intel, an AI platform that audits the reasoning behind high-stakes decisions. He pairs behavioral-economics research with full-stack execution. Born in the United States and raised between Lagos and the UK.

## About Folahan Williams

- 16-year-old founder and software engineer.
- Founder & CEO of Decision Intel (https://decision-intel.com), a reasoning-audit platform that surfaces cognitive biases and weak assumptions in strategic decisions and grades decision quality.
- Published research: "The Neuro-Cognitive Roots of the 2008 UK Financial Crisis" — an honors thesis arguing the crash was driven by cognitive biases and hormonal (cortisol/testosterone) feedback loops.
- Co-founder of Finding Finance, a student-led financial-literacy initiative teaching finance and behavioral psychology to younger students.
- Gave a TED-style talk on metacognition.
- Areas of expertise: behavioral economics, decision quality, cognitive bias, artificial intelligence, behavioral finance, metacognition.
- Education: TASIS, The American School in England (expected 2027).

## Decision Intel

Decision Intel is a reasoning-audit platform founded by Folahan Williams. It reads strategic memos, surfaces the cognitive biases and weak assumptions in the reasoning before a decision is made, and grades decision quality on logic, evidence, and bias resistance. It includes a web app, a browser extension, and a multi-stage AI pipeline that audits 22 cognitive biases.

## Portfolio (https://folahanwilliams.com/portfolio)

What Folahan has built, each with what he built, the hard part, what he learned, where it stands, and the bet it was. Everything was built solo.

- **Decision Intel** (2025 – now, live): his startup. Software that checks the reasoning behind a big investment decision before the money is committed, for private-equity investment committees. Compares each deal against 1,307 past merger filings, with 34 automatic checks for structural weak spots. https://decision-intel.com
- **Sentinel** (Mar – Jun 2026, live, paper money only): an AI market-intelligence system that reads 42 news feeds, uses five AI analysts including a red team that argues against every idea, and calibrates its confidence against its own track record. https://sentinel-nine-sable.vercel.app
- **Portfolio Intelligence Dashboard, Sankore** (summer 2026, shipped in three weeks during an Investment Analyst internship): one screen showing a fund manager holdings, exposure, risk and performance attribution, with limit alerts, a what-if scenario tool, and figures double-checked to within 0.1%.
- **Nexus / QuestFlow** (Feb – Jul 2026, open source): a productivity app that turns a to-do list into a role-playing game, with an AI coach that can take real actions in the app. https://github.com/FolahanWilliams/nexus-tracker
- **Teaching**: spoke at a women in tech event in London, teaching women how to apply AI in their own businesses.

His operating philosophy, from David Gardner's Rule Breaker Investing: the most a stock can fall is 100%, but its upside has no ceiling, so he looks for asymmetric opportunities, small downside and open-ended upside, in markets and in life.
